title: Ava's Green Garden Helpers
introLine: Hi Ava! Let's discover how special people help our nature world grow and stay healthy.
closingLine: Now it is your turn to help! Can you match the tools to the right nature helper?

scenes.title: The Park Ranger
scenes.narration: Meet Ranger Sam! He protects the tall trees and sparkling rivers. He makes sure the forest is a safe home for all the fluffy squirrels and chirping birds.
scenes.imagePrompt: A friendly park ranger in a green uniform standing in a lush forest with a wooden bridge and a blue river, polished 2d children educational game art.

scenes.title: The Community Gardener
scenes.narration: Next is Maya. She plants colorful flowers and yummy vegetables for everyone to share. Her garden makes the whole neighborhood smile with bright petals and green leaves.
scenes.imagePrompt: A smiling woman in a sun hat planting bright red tulips and green sprouts in a sunny community garden, polished 2d children educational game art.
